purpose: Conservative crop/transparency repairs in the existing medieval pixel-art style. Recovered full artwork from original sprite sheets wherever available; these eleven cutouts repair missing outlines or poor source transparency. Original generated files remain outside the repository at their tool-provided paths.

atlases.instruction: Restore the missing jar bottom, mask beak/hood hem, willow stick ends and theriac bottle base; isolated complete icons with transparent margins.
Restore complete left outlines for teaching book, cart and parchment map; remove blue fringe around purse while preserving the familiar purse and coins; generous transparent margins.
Restore the full sack knot, spear point and ox horns/outlines; one row, three isolated original-style icons.

packing: scripts/repair_game_icon_crops.py extracts the reviewed atlas cells, removes encoder transparency dust, trims to subject, uses nearest-neighbour sizing and centres each on a 128px RGBA canvas with an 8px margin. No generative redraw is applied to the 41 icons recovered from the original sheets or the three scrap-only repairs.
